title: OpenAI Codex Commands: CLI, App & IDE Cheat Sheet

The Kingy article was first published on May 12, 2026 and refreshed on September 4, 2026.

facts.fact: Per OpenAI's CLI docs as cited by Kingy, Codex runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and first launch prompts the user to sign in.

facts.fact: The command `npm i -g @openai/codex` installs the Codex CLI globally.
OpenAI's docs list three /personality modes: friendly, pragmatic, and none.
facts.quote: OpenAI’s docs list those three personality modes.

facts.fact: Per Kingy, the /side command is not available inside nested side or review modes.
